high_level_description: This image is a meme shared on Instagram, featuring two panels of an illustrated comic strip. The top panel shows a man standing outside a small, modern house under construction, while another man stands nearby pointing at the house. The text above the image reads: "PEOPLE THAT DON'T HAVE THE SAME VISION AS YOU WILL NEVER UNDERSTAND WHY YOU WORK SO HARD OR DISTANCE YOURSELF AT TIMES." The bottom panel depicts the same man from the first panel standing confidently with his arms crossed in front of a completed, larger, and more elaborate house.
